moments.text: Infrared view framed by black redaction boxes: after a blank grey start, a bright light with a long reflection below flares just upper left of the crosshair.
A dark offshore structure with cranes stands on the water right of the crosshair, reflected below, and drifts off the right edge.
After a blank grey moment the view shows a grey textured surface with dark patches; a small bright spot darts around the frame.
A square box appears at the centre; the bright spot loops around it, passing below, far left and then above it.
Small cyan brackets lock onto the spot beside a dark round patch upper right of the crosshair, and it stays there.
After a blank frame the sensor zooms in: the bracketed spot sits upper right of the crosshair on a smooth bright background.
The sensor zooms in further; the bracketed spot grows into a small white shape.
Another zoom step: the white shape shows a pale streak hanging below it, holding upper right of the crosshair.
The shape blurs into a bright blob that sweeps left across the upper half and out of the frame in about 0.2 s. Use frame step.
The picture goes black, zooms out to the textured surface, then flicks through plain grey views with no spot.
Zoomed in again, the bracketed spot is back upper right of the crosshair and grows into the white shape with a streak below.
The shape is gone; the view goes dark, zooms out and cycles through bright and grey views to the end.
